answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 689 Country: India Title: Can you please give some information whether these food items are halaal or haraam? Question: Assalam alaikum! These days we are confronted with various food products available in the market, in India whose ingredients include codes like these:E473, E474, E475, E476, E477, E478, E631, E635, E640, E920 and many more which some people consider to be haraam.Can you please give some information whether these food items are halaal or haraam? Answer ID: 689 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 790=559/H) We have no confirmation about the code numbers being Haram. You should write the ingredients of the product, then we can have a say. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
